dedupe_keys.name: avatar high reynolds number tests on airfoil du00 w 212

description: Ceyhan Ozlem and colleagues publish this resource through Zenodo. The DNW high-pressure wind-tunnel campaign in Göttingen tests the DU00-W-212 airfoil at high Reynolds number and low Mach number to support simulation and validation of aerodynamic models in that range. Native file descriptors list a data archive and measured/nominal coordinate files, alongside the test description. This establishes an actual published data component with its laboratory campaign. The inspected metadata do not enumerate the full signal schema or every operating point. No archive was opened, and a deposited data file does not by itself verify measurement quality or unrestricted reuse beyond the stated licence. Coverage is limited to the stated models, observations and application settings. Native metadata gives open access and the licence label cc-by-nc-nd-4.0. These terms describe the deposit; software and companion-data terms are distinguished where separately established. Only descriptive metadata and file descriptors were inspected; linked data, code and document bodies were not opened.
